facts_for_explanation.what_it_is: A penalty because the employer's payroll report (Full Payment Submission) reached HMRC late, or a month with no payments wasn't reported. HMRC sends penalty notices every quarter.
facts_for_explanation.estimates: If reports are missing, HMRC may raise an estimated charge (a 'specified charge'). Only sending the missing report replaces it with the real amount.
facts_for_explanation.how_to_appeal: Online in HMRC's PAYE for employers service ('Appeal a penalty'), or by post to: National Insurance Contributions and Employers Office, HM Revenue and Customs, BX9 1BX. Quote the unique ID of each penalty from the notice. Usually within 30 days.
facts_for_explanation.pay: Paying within 30 days of the notice avoids interest.
